title: MainScene and TradeScene become real Scene instances (no static state); tooltip on Scene
description:
Repo plan phase 2.3. MainScene (847 lines) and TradeScene hold all their state in statics read from 36 files (15 in gui/terminal/commands, 5 in the 2D tools, plus geometry, graphics and automation), and are started in-process (LoadIxCommand.java:82 MainScene.main; StartNewGameAction.java:33 TradeScene.startNewGame). Make both extend Scene with instance state, launched by id or swapped in by the menu; the static readers go through the current scene or a passed host. The identical static tooltip code (MainScene 691-721, TradeScene 351-379) becomes one tooltip on Scene. Layer inversions to remove on the way: Camera2D.reset reading MainScene.tool (Camera2D.java:244-252), ShaderProgram reporting hot-reload errors through MainScene.terminal (ShaderProgram.java:431), MouseTrap and Toggle importing scenes.main.

Rulings that apply (user, 2026-10-17): no class renames where avoidable (classes move package and keep their names; Camera stays the parent of Camera2D/Camera3D; MeshNode keeps its name); scenes and tools keep declaring their controls in a method mapping keys to functions; Palettes is the colour class patch colours merge into. Full plan and evidence: $REPO_HOME/ai-workspace/reports/repo-plan-2026-10-17.md.
definition-of-done:
1. No static mutable state on MainScene or TradeScene; nothing outside scenes/main and scenes/trade imports them except launch wiring.
2. TSP editing, terminal commands, trade game start, route planning behave as before.
3. Unit suite and trade scenario CLI checks pass.
4. Launch entries and screenshots.
testing-plan:
1. mvn test; ixdar-cli trade scenarios.
2. Live: load a .ix, run terminal commands, start a trade game, plan a route.
changes-made: MainScene and TradeScene extend Scene with instance state only (no static mutable fields left). Scene gains switchTo/paintFrame: a scene hands the window to its successor after the frame (old deactivated, new made Scene.instance, activated, initGL'd on first showing, rebound to the automation runtime); IxdarWindow (GLFW + headless) and WebLauncher paint through paintFrame, and the window, not the Scene constructor, starts/rebinds automation. MenuScene no longer hand-draws either: Start New Game, the debug Load/Continue items and the ld/nw/rld commands switch the window (TradeScene.startNewGame, MainScene.open); Escape switches back to the scene each was opened from (backScene). ixdar-canvas builds MainScene over a fresh MenuScene in CanvasSceneMap.

Tooltip moved onto Scene (toolTip/showToolTip, setTooltipText/clearTooltipText, tooltipBounds, drawTooltip), replacing the two static copies; HyperString shows tooltips on Scene.instance and takes highlight/clear actions for hover knots and segments instead of calling MainScene. State reports mode/trade/terminal/info/tooltip from the automation runtime's current scene.

Layer inversions removed: Camera2D.reset frames an optional resetTarget supplier (MainScene supplies hover/selected knot) instead of reading MainScene; ShaderProgram reports hot-reload IO errors through Platforms.log; MouseTrap no longer holds or imports MainScene (paneAt/paneClicked/paneHovered hooks, overridden by the new scenes/main/MainSceneMouseTrap); KeyGuy release shortcuts moved into a sceneKeyReleased hook (MainSceneKeyGuy keeps them off, as when the inactive menu host owned them); Terminal and InfoPane no longer import MainScene; Drawing's dead drawSingleCutMatch removed. Toggle itself imports nothing from scenes.main (it lives there); MouseTrap/KeyGuy still read Toggle for pane focus.

Remaining static readers (tools/knot, the TSP terminal commands, Knot/Segment hyperstrings, Grid coordinate readouts) go through MainScene.current() (the current Scene cast) or a passed host (MainSceneKeyGuy/MainSceneMouseTrap/InfoPane, trade tools and handlers via their TradeScene). TradeScene fields renamed where they would hide Scene's: activeTool->activeTradeTool, camera->mapCamera, pointSet->cityPoints; MainScene camera->editorCamera, shell->tourShell.
